  1. Define CLI Interface & Arguments: Decide on the invocation syntax (e.g.,
  positional expression string like calc "2 + 3 * 4" or subcommands/flags)
  and interactive REPL mode support.
  2. Implement Tokenizer (Lexer): Parse the input string into tokens such as
  numbers (integers/floats), arithmetic operators (+, -, *, /, ^), and
  parentheses ((, )).
  3. Implement Expression Parser & Evaluator: Build a recursive-descent or
  Shunting-Yard parser that enforces operator precedence, associativity, and
  parentheses grouping, then evaluates the resulting expression safely.
  4. Add Error Handling & Edge Cases: Handle invalid syntax, division by zero,
  mismatched parentheses, and overflow/NaN cases with clear, non-zero exit
  codes and user-friendly error messages.
  5. Write Tests & Package: Add unit and CLI integration tests covering
  arithmetic operations and error conditions, then configure an executable
  entry point and usage help (--help).
